lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity local maxima arranged in roughly vertical columns. Spot density is highest in the anterior region near the gills where centroids are smaller and more closely packed, transitioning to larger, more widely spaced blobs with lower edge-definition in the posterior direction.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated luminance are visible, intersecting with horizontal spot rows to form a grid-like configuration. These intersections serve as primary anchor nodes for pattern mapping across the visible lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible running parallel to the lateral line. Each ridge is defined by a sharp intensity gradient, with high-luminance pixels on the dorsal-facing edge and lower-intensity shadow pixels on the ventral-facing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, dark, elongated silhouettes located ventrally to the main body mass, consistent with the pixel footprint of commensal organisms such as remoras.
